author: Nerdstalgic
description:
The future of the MCU might depend on....Cyclops?

For years, Scott Summers has been one of the most important characters in X-Men comics and animation. But the live action movies never quite figured out what to do with him, often reducing Cyclops to a supporting player in Wolverine's story.

Now Marvel has another chance.

With James Marsden returning as Cyclops in Avengers: Doomsday and the X-Men moving toward the center of Marvel's larger cinematic universe, Scott Summers is finally getting the spotlight he never received during the original Fox era.

But why does Cyclops matter so much to the future of the X-Men and the MCU as a whole?

#cyclops #xmen #avengersdoomsday #wolverine
title: Why Cyclops Is The Key To Saving The MCU
